sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 24 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPCX、TSLA、MU、NBIS、SPY。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Index divergence persists, with QQQ leading declines: As of 11:09 ET, about 99 minutes after the open, SPY was at 739.73 (+0.23%) and DIA was up 0.37%, while QQQ stood at 686.33 (-0.82%, intraday low of 683.58) and IWM was down 0.17%. The broader market appeared calm on the surface, but tech and semiconductors were bleeding internally—the community repeatedly complained about the extreme divergence of "SPY green, my entire portfolio red."
  • Memory complex continues to collapse: MU -6% (breaking below 930, with an intraday low of 919), SNDK -8.2%, MRVL -6.7%, AVGO -2.6%, and AMD -1.7%. Catalysts included a chip sell-off triggered by Samsung's earnings, a bearish Morgan Stanley report on memory, and institutional concerns over a record contraction in the global smartphone market in 2026, projected at -13%.
  • INTC turns red despite its "best earnings ever": Intel significantly beat expectations after hours, with revenue of $16.1 billion, up 25%, and non-GAAP EPS of 0.42, far above the 0.22 estimate, while data center/AI revenue rose 59%. Shares surged as much as 14% to above $110 after hours, only to turn red after the open, currently down 3.84% at 96.21. "Even beats get sold" became the market's defining sentiment.
  • AXP earnings trap: American Express posted EPS of 4.53, above expectations, but revenue of $19.64 billion slightly missed estimates, while full-year profit guidance remained unchanged. Shares fell 5.26% to 322.87. The community was stunned that "even a blue-chip value stock is getting dumped like a memory stock."
  • Tariffs 2.0 take effect: Trump's new round of Section 301 tariffs, ranging from 10% to 12.5% and targeting nearly all U.S. imports, took effect today. The community's reaction showed diminishing sensitivity, with most treating it as background noise.
  • Iran conflict escalates alongside oil-price moves: The U.S.-Iran war entered its 24th day, with airstrikes continuing for a 12th consecutive night. Trump threatened to destroy Iran's bridges and power plants if Iran attacks ships in the Strait of Hormuz, while Netanyahu is set to visit the U.S. next Tuesday. The community interpreted Netanyahu's visit as a two-way signal: either a peace agreement or an escalation over the weekend. Oddly, oil prices declined today despite rising geopolitical tensions.
  • TSLA approaches 300: The post-earnings collapse continued, with shares down 3.28% at 309 after touching an intraday low of 308.5. The community loudly called for it to be "sent to 300" or "sacrificed for rotation."

社区氛围：整体气氛是一种投降式的黑色幽默和虚无主义。大多数参与者都完全投资并陷入亏损头寸，放弃了预测市场方向的尝试，并将 SPY 的剧烈来回波动归咎于做市商和算法的“操纵和止损狩猎”，“就像垃圾币/迷因币一样”。其基本基调是看跌和疲惫，但又夹杂着“积极逢低买入”的机械冲动。

恐惧/贪婪：接近极度恐惧。多条评论明确指出，“我们基本上正走向极度恐惧”，而看跌/看涨期权定位严重偏向看跌方向。然而值得注意的是，VIX 今天收高，这是“隐性下跌”的一个例子，指数本身并未崩溃，但个别板块在内部吸收了损失。恐惧集中在期权和个股上，而不是波动率指数上。

情绪与实际价格走势：社区感觉好像正在目睹“世界末日/大屠杀”，但 SPY 仅上涨 0.2%，QQQ 仅下跌 0.8%。一条获得高度评价的评论抓住了这种脱节：当该指数最大权重成分股的 ATH 已下跌 20-30% 时，SPY 仍仅比 ATH 低 2.5%。从根本上说，这反映了从半导体/人工智能转向以 AAPL 和 DIA 为主的成分股，而不是系统性崩溃。散户交易员集中投资内存、空间、光学模块和高贝塔系数的股票，这使得他们的经历比指数显示的要痛苦得多。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及看涨/看跌情绪核心观点总结
MU45+看跌（高度分化）尽管有积极的催化剂，但仍跌破 930，最大痛苦接近 940； “一年内上涨9倍后估值拉长”与“内在价值受到压制，一旦强制平仓被清除，就会反弹”；逢低买家屡受困；讽刺性地提到“本世纪第 14 个买入机会”；观看 900/1000 级别
SPY40+中性至看跌“就像屎币一样，每 10 分钟改变一次方向”；激烈捍卫738-740，而社区呼吁730/725甚至低于700；表面收益是再平衡造成的幻觉； 0DTE交易双方都被碾压的战场
TSLA38强烈看跌财报后无底，破320逼近300；社区要求 300、“2 fittie”甚至低于 100；年初至今 -32%； 340 PE仍被认为“荒谬”； Cathie 逢低买入，视为逆向指标；看跌期权产生巨大收益
SPCX30强烈看跌下跌5%，跌破112，8/4禁售期满后恐80/50； “毒害整个市场的罪魁祸首”；员工被迫眼睁睁地看着自己的锁定股票被抛售； TSLA 的反射性死亡螺旋
INTC25中立（有争议）有史以来最强劲的财报推动股价在盘后上涨 14%，但随后低开并下跌 3.8%；教科书上的“连节拍都卖了”的例子；一年内上涨 5 倍后估值完全定价与逢低买入之间的争论；克莱默诅咒；期权持有者坐过山车到零
